types.description: An app deployed as one Railway service in one Railway environment. Takes every deployment.base attribute (@app, @environment, @domains, @replicas, @region, @branch, @secrets, and value.* children) and adds where it lives on Railway.
types.whenToUse: Each (app, environment) pair that runs on Railway.

children.name: service
children.description: The Railway service's name. Absent means the app's name.

children.name: repo
children.description: The GitHub repository Railway builds the service from, as `owner/name`. A deployment names a @repo or an @image: the generated file must declare the source, because a plan of a service with none disconnects it.

children.name: image
children.description: The container image Railway runs instead of building from a repository (`ghcr.io/acme/worker:1.2.3`).

children.name: checkSuites
children.description: Whether a push waits for the repository's GitHub check suites to pass before Railway deploys it. Absent means Railway's own setting is left as it is.
